blocks.title: What every widget promises
blocks.body: Stable id, typed props, no fetch or write side effects in v0, and it works under every theme and the reading view - or it documents the rare exception.

blocks.title: Widget selection rule
blocks.body: A widget enters the shared renderer only when more than one real artifact benefits from it.

blocks.heading: Don't prebuild twenty widgets
blocks.body: Start with the few that two real artifacts need. Earn the rest by use.
